name: io.github.justice8096/sagemath-mcp-server
description: MCP server wrapping SageMath's full computer algebra system — 10 symbolic-math tools for LLMs.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-call SageMath timeout in milliseconds. Default 30000.

environmentVariables.name: SAGE_DOCKER_IMAGE
environmentVariables.description: Docker image used when SageMath is not installed locally. Default sagemath/sagemath:latest.

environmentVariables.name: API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: If set, HTTP transport requires matching API_KEY header. Ignored for stdio.
